mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.spu_name, p.sub_title, p.category_id, p.main_img, p.status, p.created_at, MIN(s.price) AS min_price FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_sku s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.spu_name, p.sub_title, p.category_id, p.main_img, p.status, p.created_at ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
